description: INDICIA DESK's decision journal: options strategies tracked at real Deribit bid/ask prices (paper account), with every closed trade, wins and losses. Returns per-strategy trade counts, win rate and average result, and the latest closed trades. Use to show how rule-based options strategies actually performed. Live entry signals and exact structures are not available here.

strategy.description: Part of a strategy name, e.g. "Skew", "Fear Spike". Omit to list all.
